scope: Independent full-production target; scaffold does not complete these tasks.

items.title: Approved design/assets and catalog navigation
items.acceptance: All families discoverable; real assets approved; mobile and keyboard checks pass.

items.title: Product detail and category-aware search
items.acceptance: Approved prices/options, relevant filters, typo/no-result recovery and scale imagery verified.

items.title: Persistent accessible personalization
items.acceptance: Refresh/back/interrupted upload retain permitted data; non-drag positioning; price breakdown.

items.title: Guest checkout and gift experience
items.acceptance: Required configuration survives express checkout; gift recipient is not contacted inadvertently.

items.title: Quotes/events/proofs/order portal
items.acceptance: Distinct requested/held/confirmed and exact proof-version approval; unauthorized links denied.

items.title: Owner dashboard and complete journey polish
items.acceptance: Paid/artwork/production states distinct; real phone and assistive-technology verification.

items.title: Approve normalized catalog and business policies
items.acceptance: Source provenance and contradictions resolved; no fixture price/inventory is sellable.

items.title: Durable pricing/cart/stock contracts
items.acceptance: Integer money, shared blank stock, quantity/set/name rules and server validation tested.

items.title: Payment adapter and reconciliation
items.acceptance: Hosted test checkout; signed/idempotent webhook; duplicate/retry/failure tests; no card data.

items.title: Artwork/proof/production state machines
items.acceptance: Exact proof version and verified payment/capacity gate production; revision invalidates approval.

items.title: Quotes and event booking/deposits
items.acceptance: Authoritative capacity/hold expiry, quote version, deposit/balance and staff approval tested.

items.title: Fulfillment/refunds/notifications
items.acceptance: Durable outbox, shipping/pickup/status, approved refunds and customer ownership tests.

items.title: Approved public knowledge pipeline
items.acceptance: Only reviewed public data; no archive/costs/private files; provenance and refresh tested.

items.title: Bounded Bedrock tool assistant
items.acceptance: Strict tool schemas and budgets; no raw database or money/production write privileges.

items.title: Useful product recommendations
items.acceptance: Real eligible products and authoritative prices/deadlines; baseline comparison and held-out scenarios.

items.title: Artwork screening and honest previews
items.acceptance: Supported formats/consent; uncertainty and staff handoff; no guarantee of final engraving.

items.title: Safety/privacy/failure evaluation
items.acceptance: Injection, tool abuse, PII leakage, timeout and budget tests; commerce works without AI.

items.title: Owner assistance and human controls
items.acceptance: Draft-only replies/actions; high-impact changes require deterministic authorization/approval.

items.title: AWS environment and resource implementation
items.acceptance: Owner-approved account/region/budget; least-privilege reviewed Terraform plan before apply.

items.title: Authentication/files/secrets boundaries
items.acceptance: Cognito roles and API ownership; private validated uploads; no secret or customer data exposure.

items.title: Verified CI and non-production delivery
items.acceptance: Build/test/scan immutable images; scoped OIDC; gated deploy/rollback; archive excluded.

items.title: Observability and recovery
items.acceptance: Redacted logs, alarms, bounded retries, backup restore and payment reconciliation drill.

items.title: Whole-system production acceptance
items.acceptance: Retail/bulk/event/gift/proof failure journeys; real phones; WCAG and performance evidence.

items.title: Live launch and operating handoff
items.acceptance: All gates passed; owner approves DNS/payment/mail cutover; maintenance and incident ownership.
